sentences.text:
SANAP, J.
DATE : 12/03/2024 Heard.
2.
This is an application for condonation of 1319 days delay caused in filing appeal against impugned judgment and award, dated 05.04.2014 passed by the Joint Civil Judge (Sr. Dn.) Buldhana.
The reasons have been stated in the application.
In view of the reasons, the application is allowed.
3. Delay of 1319 days caused in filing cross objection stands condoned.

It is made clear that in view of the decision in the case of New Okhla Industrial Development Authority Vs. Rameshwar @ Ramesh Chandra Sharma (Dead), through Legal Heir and another The Executive Engineer, Khadakpurna ... vs Nivrutti Dnyandev Dandge (Deshmukh) ... on 12 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81013336/
1 (2022 SCC Online SC 1599), the original land owners/ claimants/appellants herein shall not be entitled to get any statutory benefits, including the interest payable under the Land Acquisition Act on the enhanced amount of compensation for the delayed period, in case the appeal is allowed.
5. The cross objection be registered.
6. The civil application stands disposed of, accordingly.
CROSS OBJECTION (St.) NO. 641 OF 2022 7.

8. ADMIT.
9.

Learned AGP waives service of notice on behalf of respondent Nos. 4 and 5.
10.
Learned Advocate Mr R.D. Kalra waives service of notice on behalf of Executive Engineer.
FIRST APPEAL NO.976 OF 2016 11.
Advocate for the appellant shall file paper book 3 15 fa 976.16.odt..odt within three weeks.
12. If paper book is not filed within three weeks then appellant shall pay costs of Rs.5,000/-.
